name: SmartX Ingestion Opt C v1.0.2 -- Productionize DS Emit + Dead-Lambda Cleanup + 2nd-Producer Cross-Validation
description: Closes the smartx-pipeline architecture transition begun by v1.0.1's Opt A Lambda neutralization (CEO-direct broader-1b + Cohort-0-IN methodology pivot via DS Base 2026-05-19). v1.0.1 made DS Base's `build_legacy_compat_emit.py` (225df40bc) the sole SoT for non_model_assets.json but left the Lambda code + IAM dangling (dead-but-harmless append_non_model_today step + SmartX cache IAM grant) AND left the producer running manual-only (legacy file goes stale daily without an interim daily-fire mechanism). Opt C v1.0.2 closes the gap permanently: (1) productionizes DS Base's emit as scheduled infrastructure (AE 0.7 picks Lambda+EventBridge cron OR SSM RunDocument scheduled OR equivalent); (2) cleans dead Lambda code + retires unused IAM grants; (3) ships a 2nd-producer cross-validation gate (defense layer cross-checking the new SoT producer against an independent reference, fail-LOUD on divergence) -- mirrors the masking-class memory rider 2 framing (single-producer brittleness; second-producer cross-check catches cohort-level errors that identity_1 mask). Acceleration to FIRST in AE 0.7 post-v1.0.1 queue per CTO 2026-05-19 disposition -- active-staleness (legacy file daily-stale without daily-fire) beats preventive-defense (ADHC_DSFLOW.007 + ADVI_INFALM.001 push by ~0.5d, no broken dependencies, both independent infrastructure on different pipelines).
phase: Phase 0 -- DISPATCHED 2026-05-19 ~16:0XZ + SCOPE-REDUCED ~17:1XZ + DEMOTED to SECOND-after-v1.0.1 in AE 0.7 queue (2.0.0_SA_COO per 1.0.0_SA_CTO 2nd disposition this turn on the 5/19 Cohort 0 incident follow-up). Single Phase-0 productionization TO SXIN_PRODCT.001 (AE 0.7.0): originally bundled 3 Opt C scope items (scheduled-emit infrastructure + dead-Lambda cleanup + 2nd-producer cross-validation gate); SCOPE-REDUCED to 2 items -- the 2nd-producer cross-validation gate MOVES to MDPF_ASSETS.019 (DS Base lane) per CTO architectural placement reasoning (cross-validation lives where reconcile lives, adjacent to the partners-present sentinel .019 also adds). This TO now ships (1) productionize DS emit as scheduled + (2) dead-Lambda cleanup. ~0.5d AE wall preserved. QUEUE RE-SEQUENCE: DEMOTED from FIRST to SECOND in AE 0.7 post-v1.0.1 queue -- MDPF_ASSETS.018 (chain integration, prevent-class for 5/19 partner-absence defect) preempts. New sequence: v1.0.1 -> MDPF_ASSETS.018 -> SXIN_PRODCT.001 -> ADHC_DSFLOW.007 -> ADVI_INFALM.001. Reasoning: scheduled emit value depends on platinum being correct; fix the source-of-truth (.018) first, then schedule the refresh. Deadline 2026-05-22 preserved. Bridge during gap: DS Base interim daily-fire mechanism (CTO disposition compound (a) from earlier this turn). RAVC2 to COO + CC CTO + DS Base.
blocking: SXIN_PRODCT.001 PENDING (DISPATCHED 2026-05-19, scope-reduced + queue-demoted later same turn). Gates on AE 0.7's v1.0.1 ship landing (tomorrow 2026-05-20 14:00 UTC; CEO-direct deadline) THEN MDPF_ASSETS.018 chain integration ship. Post .018 close, AE 0.7 starts SXIN_PRODCT.001. DS Base interim daily-fire (CTO disposition compound (a)) bridges the gap window between v1.0.1 and SXIN_PRODCT.001 close.
